msgid_map.At the %s no collection or rental start: Pickup or rental start is not available on %s. Please choose a different start date.

msgid_map.How many identical devices of this produ: How many identical rental units of this product can be rented at the same time.

msgid_map.e.g. will be refunded after checking the: e.g. refunded after the returned item has been inspected.
msgid_map.Price priority: weekend rate → matching: Pricing priority: weekend rate → matching pricing tier → weekday rate → standard price. Example: from 7 rental days, a package price of €129 includes 7 days; each additional rental day costs €15.
msgid_map.Only grips with exactly the right start/: Applies only when the start and return weekdays match exactly and the resulting duration is exact (e.g. Friday to Monday = 3 rental days).
msgid_map.For material sizes and priced accessorie: Use rental accessories for material variants and priced accessory items. Simple add-ons are intended for services or surcharges that do not require their own inventory items.
msgid_map.Only active bookings that have not yet b: Only active bookings that have not yet been handed over can be edited.
msgid_map.The booking change could not be saved. T: The booking change could not be saved. The previous state was restored.
msgid_map.The WooCommerce order position for the b: The WooCommerce order item for the booking was not found. The change was reverted.
msgid_map.The rental data of the WooCommerce order: The rental data on the WooCommerce order item is incomplete. The change was reverted.
msgid_map.Rental: Period of booking #%d administra: Rental: The period for booking #%d was changed by an administrator. Financial line items were not recalculated automatically.
msgid_map.The order position could not be safely u: The order item could not be updated safely. The booking and equipment assignment were restored to their previous state.
msgid_map.An already handed over, returned or othe: A booking that has already been handed over, returned, or otherwise completed cannot be deleted or cancelled because its audit trail must be retained.
msgid_map.The order booking has been cancelled and: The order booking was cancelled and remains in the history to preserve its audit trail.
msgid_map.When making online payment let customer: Let the customer choose at checkout
msgid_map.Always directly with the online payment: Always collect with the online payment
